question: Should OpenClaw adopt `CLAW.md` as the canonical export and authoring format for the experimental core Claw lifecycle, rather than retaining grouped JSON as the only core package format?
rationale: The patch is a new user-facing package contract on top of an open, stacked experimental lifecycle; source review can assess implementation quality but cannot choose whether that core product surface should be accepted.

options.title: Sponsor the experimental format
options.body: Accept `CLAW.md` as the canonical experimental package format, require exact-head round-trip proof, and review it only with its parent lifecycle stack.

options.title: Keep JSON-only for now
options.body: Defer the authoring/export format change until the core Claw lifecycle itself has clear maintainer sponsorship and landing order.

options.title: Move toward an extension path
options.body: Decline the new core package contract and direct any independently useful authoring workflow to a plugin or ClawHub design that uses existing extension seams.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the experimental format
recommendation.body: Accept `CLAW.md` as the canonical experimental package format, require exact-head round-trip proof, and review it only with its parent lifecycle stack.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties this contributor to the predecessor CLAW.md implementation and the linked Claw lifecycle stack, making them the clearest technical routing candidate for a maintainer-sponsored decision.
